title: Stream MySQL Produce Dump Through Gzip
description: Pipes mysqldump through gzip, deletes the source dump after restore, and reports restore progress against the gzip file size so Hydra produce fits on the 2GB lon1 droplet.

test_plan.description: Hydra produce dump no longer buffers uncompressed SQL in PHP
steps: Merge this PR and wait for semantic-release to publish a new ngramx.phar
Confirm restore still streams the gzip dump into scratch
Confirm Dumping anonymized database writes hydra_anon.sql.gz without a sibling plain .sql and without ENOSPC or PHP OOM
Confirm the artifact uploads and shared refresh proceeds

test_plan.description: Loading dump into scratch tracks gzip file bytes
steps: Dispatch Postmaclone produce (Hydra) on postmaclone-lon1 after this PR is released
Watch Loading dump into scratch percent over time
Confirm it does not jump to 100% after only a few GB of a multi-GB gzip
Confirm 100% appears when the dump file has been fully read; Restore finished may still wait on MySQL COMMIT

test_plan.description: Dump timeout and gzip errors are visible and do not leave orphans
steps: Confirm Tests PHP 8.2 / 8.3 pass after the PHPStan assertIsResource fix
On a failed dump, the exception includes gzip stderr (for example ENOSPC)
If a dump times out, mysqldump and gzip on the runner do not keep running after the job fails
